description: "The Essential Faith of the Universal Church; Deduced from the Sacred Records" by Harriet Martineau is a theological treatise written in the early 19th century. This work presents an exploration of Christian Unitarianism, advocating for the essential truths of the faith as revealed through the Scriptures.
